product_one_liner.value: Verifiable automates provider credentialing, enrollment, and ongoing network monitoring for healthcare providers and health plans.
product_one_liner.notes: The company describes its platform as provider network management software for healthcare provider and payer organizations, and says it unifies credentialing, enrollment, and monitoring across the provider journey.

pricing_page.notes: The company homepage navigation and footer include no pricing link, while the pricing URL fetched as a 301 redirect rather than a public pricing page.

employee_band.notes: Tracxn reports an official employee count of 138, which falls within the 101–200 band.

hq_location.notes: hq_country: The company profile explicitly gives Verifiable’s headquarters as Austin, Texas, USA; the country is the United States.

founded_year.notes: Y Combinator identifies Verifiable as founded in 2019, and Tracxn independently lists Founded Year: 2019.

eng_blog.notes: The inspected blog index pages include one clearly engineering-titled post, “From Legacy to Scalable: Engineering the AI-Powered Credentialing Stack.” Its author Janan Dave is identified in the team listing as VP of Operations, and another technical CredAgent post is attributed to Amy Chait. The index does not establish two engineering-authored technical posts, so this does not meet the stated threshold for an engineering blog.

model_provider.notes: Verifiable’s subprocessor list names Anthropic, PBC and specifies that its Claude large language model supports platform-related tasks.

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: Verifiable’s official certification post states it is SOC 2 Type 2 compliant; its security page also names SOC 2 and describes annual third-party audits. No other requested certification is named in this evidence. | compliance_certs.0: The official certification post identifies SOC 2 Type 2 compliance.

last_funding.notes: funding_date: Tracxn dates the latest round to June 10, 2023, and CB Insights lists the latest Series B in June 2023; the requested year-month is 2023-06. | funding_amount_usd: Tracxn records the latest round amount as $27 million; Verifiable’s funding announcement confirms that amount for its Series B.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The live Lever careers board lists Customer Success Manager, Enterprise Customer Success Manager, and Solutions Engineer; none of the open role titles is SDR, BDR, sales/business development representative, or account executive.
